description: Two-pane collaborative session -- the same document open twice, side by side -- each pane with a debug panel below it reporting that pane's own live selection. Both copies of the document are empty: the grey placeholder text is showing in both, and both panels report their own selection as anchor and focus at offset 0 on an empty paragraph. The right pane draws the other participant's green labelled caret hard against the left edge of the line. The left pane draws the same labelled caret roughly 40% of the way across the empty first line, which in a document containing no text at all is a position no caret can occupy.
frame_source: Still extracted from the reporter's original screen recording at the url above (an Apple QuickTime .mov, ~14s). The recording itself is not shipped: nothing in the harness can play it, and every frame that shows the defect is here as a still.

description: The same two-pane session, both copies now showing the identical 17-character text "Collab demoasdasd". The two debug panels report the participants' own carets in different places: offset 0 in the left pane, offset 17 (the end of the text) in the right pane. The left pane draws the other participant's green labelled caret at the end of the text, which matches the offset 17 the right pane reports for itself. The right pane draws the other participant's labelled caret about ten characters into the text, while the pane that participant is working in reports their caret at offset 0 -- so one of the two drawn carets corresponds to where that person is and the other does not.
frame_source: Still extracted from the reporter's original screen recording at the url above (an Apple QuickTime .mov, ~14s). The recording itself is not shipped: nothing in the harness can play it, and every frame that shows the defect is here as a still.

description: The same session a few seconds later, both panes showing the identical 20-character text "Codddllab demoasdasd". The debug panels now report offset 20 (left pane, the end of the text) and offset 3 (right pane). Here neither drawn caret matches: the left pane draws the other participant's labelled caret near the end of the text although the pane that participant is working in reports offset 3, and the right pane draws it a few characters into the text although the other pane reports offset 20.
